result.answer: The bed was WARD-B bed BAY2-02. When this patient's transfer there (event time 08:30 UTC) reached the bed-management system, it said no, because the bed was still held by another patient's stay, shown as encounter ENC-T2. That patient had held the bed since 08:00 UTC. Shutter shows only that token, not who the person is. That patient was moved to WARD-C bed BAY1-07 (event time 08:20 UTC). That move has now been recorded, and the bed-management system now shows them in WARD-C BAY1-07, so the bed is free of them. This patient is still shown in WARD-A bed BAY1-03, where they were admitted at 08:05 UTC. Because the other patient has left, Shutter will send this transfer again, exactly as it was. A test run said the bed-management system would accept it. The site's setting lets this happen without a person approving it. If the bed turns out to be taken after all, the system will refuse again, so nobody gets double-booked. Under a stricter setting, an approver would have been asked first.
